title: NFT Payload Storage
key_points: Explains how NFT payload storage works on the XRP Ledger.
Describes the structure and components of an NFT payload.
Details the process for creating, storing, and managing NFT payloads.
limitations: Assumes familiarity with XRPL concepts and terminology
Some technical details may be challenging for non-technical readers
asserts: NFT payload storage allows creators to store metadata associated with an NFT on the XRP Ledger, providing immutability, transparency, and decentralization.
scope: Explains how NFT payload storage works on the XRP Ledger, focusing on the structure of payloads and the process for creating, storing, and managing them.
